Faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Faq.subtitle: Key things to know before getting started with WeeComi.

items.q: WHAT KIND OF PRODUCTS DO YOU BUILD?
items.a: WeeComi builds, supports and updates independent digital products across commerce, artificial intelligence, finance and business management.

items.q: ARE THE PRODUCTS CONNECTED TO EACH OTHER?
items.a: No. Each product works independently in its own domain. The shared layer is WeeComi's technology, support and corporate quality standard.

items.q: WHICH MARKETS DO YOU FOCUS ON?
items.a: We operate from Turkey and support multilingual experiences for Azerbaijan, Georgia, Russia and broader European growth targets.

items.q: HOW DO WE CHOOSE THE RIGHT PRODUCT FOR OUR BUSINESS?
items.a: We review your need together and recommend the most suitable independent WeeComi product, along with a clear starting path when needed.
